name: MagFlap™ Travel & Card Wallet
tagline: Ultra-slim RFID bifold with quick-eject magnetic tab
description: Engineered for modern travel and daily carry, the MagFlap™ combines full-grain Tuscan vegetable-tanned hide with an aerospace-grade aluminum card sleeve. Features our patented magnetic thumb-ejector that fans out up to 6 cards instantly while blocking RFID scanners.

technicalSpecs.careInstructions: Condition biannually with natural beeswax leather balm. Wipe clean with a dry cotton cloth.

features: Patented MagFlap™ instant card fanning mechanism
Aerospace-grade aluminum RFID blocking chamber (1-6 cards)
Exterior quick-draw slot for transit pass or tap payment
Full-grain cowhide that develops a rich, golden patina over time
Dedicated inner sleeve for folded banknotes and business cards
Hand-burnished, beeswax-sealed edges

name: Artisan Solid Brass Leather Belt
tagline: 3.8mm thick single-cut bridle hide with forged brass hardware
description: Crafted from a single unbroken cut of 3.8mm heavyweight bridle leather. Built without synthetic fillers, cardboard, or bonded scraps. Anchored by a solid forged Italian brass buckle fastened with Chicago screws for a lifetime of dependable duty.

technicalSpecs.dimensions: Width: 35 mm (1.38 inches), Custom waist sizing
technicalSpecs.careInstructions: Buff with horsehair brush. Apply neat's-foot oil once yearly.

features: Single-ply 10oz heavy steer hide — zero peeling or stretching
Solid cast brass buckle with antique brushed patina
Removable Chicago screws allow buckle swap customization
7 teardrop adjustment holes spaced 1 inch apart
Hand-dyed and wax-beveled bevel edges for smooth friction-free threading

name: Heritage 8-Card Classic Bifold
tagline: Traditional hand-stitched wallet with dual cash divider
description: The quintessential gentleman's billfold, reimagined with ultra-slim internal skiving to prevent pocket bulk. Features 8 precision-cut card slots, 2 hidden receipt pockets, and a full-length currency compartment lined with supple lambskin.

technicalSpecs.careInstructions: Rub minor scuffs with fingertips to redistribute natural surface oils.

features: 8 precision staggered card pockets with reinforced thumb notches
Dual-chamber banknote divider for domestic and foreign currency
Ultra-thin skived edges for a featherweight, flat silhouette
German braided polyester thread stitching for extreme tensile durability
RFID protective shielding integrated between leather layers

name: Executive Long Passport Wallet
tagline: Handcrafted boarding pass, passport, and multi-currency folio
description: Designed for global travelers and discerning executives. Holds standard international passports, unfolded banknotes, boarding passes, 12 credit cards, and a micro travel pen. Finished with hand-creased margins and gold foil atelier stamp.

technicalSpecs.careInstructions: Store in included cotton dust bag when not traveling.

features: Dedicated passport pouch fits all biometric passport booklets
12 individual card slots + 2 deep currency & travel document pockets
Quick-slip boarding pass slot on back cover
Hidden SIM card and ejector pin compartment
Magnetic closure holds securely without scratching leather

name: Atelier Pebbled Leather Tote
tagline: Supple full-grain day tote with reinforced double handles
description: The quintessential daily luxury tote. Sculpted from buttery pebbled cowhide that resists moisture and scratches. Features generous proportions to cradle a 14-inch laptop, personal planner, and makeup pouch, with a magnetic top bridge closure.

technicalSpecs.dimensions: 36.0 cm x 30.0 cm x 13.0 cm (Handle drop: 24 cm)
technicalSpecs.careInstructions: Wipe with damp microfiber cloth. Store stuffed with tissue to maintain shape.

features: Fits laptops up to 14 inches with protective padded pocket
Solid brass metal feet protect base from street abrasion
Interior zippered valuables pocket + dual phone drop pockets
Supple rolled shoulder handles engineered for zero shoulder strain
Includes detachable leather key leash with brass snap hook

name: Slimline 4-Card Front Pocket Cardholder
tagline: Featherlight 4mm profile for front-pocket minimalist carry
description: Designed for the pure minimalist. Skived to an extraordinary 4mm thickness, this front-pocket wallet carries 4 cards plus folded bills in a center thumb-accessible pouch. Fits completely imperceptibly in jeans or tailored trousers.

technicalSpecs.careInstructions: Leather naturally softens and stretches to hold up to 6 cards over first month.

features: 4 quick-access card slots (2 front, 2 back)
Center slot holds folded cash, receipts, or emergency bills
Precision curved thumb notch for effortless single-card pull
Zero lining or cardboard — 100% pure leather layers
Pocket-friendly slim form factor

name: Saddle Flap Crossbody Bag
tagline: Structured equestrian-inspired silhouette with brass turn-lock
description: An homage to classic equestrian saddlery. Constructed with structured side gussets, full-grain waxed bridle leather, and an antique brass turn-lock clasp. The adjustable strap allows seamless transition from high shoulder to relaxed crossbody carry.

technicalSpecs.careInstructions: Condition flap with natural leather cream once every 6 months.

features: Solid brass turn-lock front clasp with engraved serial number
Adjustable 7-hole strap with solid brass buckle (48 cm – 58 cm drop)
Internal divider with zipped coin and lipstick compartment
External slip pocket on reverse side for iPhone or passport
Suede-lined main chamber protects sunglasses from scratches

name: Formal Feather-Edge Dress Belt
tagline: Tapered 30mm dress belt with hand-stitched border and silver buckle
description: Tailored specifically for suit trousers and formal wear. Features a subtle domed feather-edge profile, tonal micro-stitching, and an ultra-slim satin nickel buckle for a clean, sophisticated waistline.

technicalSpecs.material: Aniline Calf Leather with Nubuck Backing
technicalSpecs.dimensions: Width: 30 mm (1.18 inches), Custom sizing 30-44 inches
technicalSpecs.careInstructions: Keep rolled or hanging straight. Wipe with leather conditioner cloth.

features: Subtle domed feather edge contoured for formal suiting
Satin nickel-plated solid brass dress buckle
Nubuck leather backing prevents color transfer to dress shirts
Perimeter saddle stitching with 9 stitches per inch density

name: Artisan Snap Leather Valet Tray
tagline: Corner-snapping catchall tray for bedside nightstand and desk EDC
description: The perfect home for your everyday essentials. Unsnaps completely flat to slip into your carry-on luggage; snaps securely in all four corners upon arrival at your hotel or home to hold keys, timepiece, coins, and cufflinks.

technicalSpecs.dimensions: Flat: 20 cm x 20 cm | Snapped: 15 cm x 15 cm x 4 cm
technicalSpecs.careInstructions: Natural patina deepens with age as keys and coins mark the hide.

features: 4 heavy-duty antique brass snap buttons in corners
Packs 100% flat for effortless business travel and vacations
Dual-layered full-grain hide for rigid sidewalls when snapped
Embossed central Atelier hallmark seal

name: MagFlap™ Carbon & Matte Edition
tagline: Carbon fiber weave reinforcement fused with bridle leather
description: Engineered for maximum rigidity and scratch resilience. Fuses 3K matte carbon fiber weave with full-grain oil-waxed leather. Holds 8 cards with quick magnetic thumb deployment and military-spec RFID interference immunity.

technicalSpecs.material: Full-Grain Cowhide with 3K Carbon Fiber Hybrid
technicalSpecs.careInstructions: Water-resistant exterior. Wipe clean with damp cloth.

features: Carbon fiber reinforced faceplates resist scratches and impact
Fast magnetic flick card ejection mechanism
Integrated elastic cash band holds 10+ bills securely
Certified 13.56 MHz RFID / NFC shielding

name: All-Weather Zip Travel Folio
tagline: Full perimeter YKK Excella brass zipper with dual passport pockets
description: The ultimate security folio for family or solo travel. Encased in an ultra-smooth Japanese YKK Excella brass zipper that seals foreign currency, coins, customs cards, dual passports, and flight tickets against loss.

technicalSpecs.material: Oil-Waxed Pull-Up Cowhide & YKK Excella Zipper
technicalSpecs.careInstructions: Lightly wax zipper teeth once annually for effortless gliding.

features: Full perimeter brass zipper ensures zero contents can slide out
Holds 2 international passports simultaneously
8 card slots + expandable zippered coin pocket
Internal micro-pen loop with complimentary silver ballpoint

name: Silent Key Clutch & Carabiner
tagline: Eliminates pocket jingle with brass bolt pivot system
description: Silent, compact, and protective. Neatly encloses 2 to 7 keys inside a full-grain leather envelope, preventing key teeth from scratching your smartphone screen in pockets or bags. Includes solid brass D-ring for car key fobs.

technicalSpecs.material: Full-Grain Vegetable Tanned Cowhide with Brass Hardware
technicalSpecs.careInstructions: Tighten brass bolt with a coin every few months to adjust key friction.

features: Accommodates 2 to 7 standard door keys inside enclosed leather sheath
Zero pocket jingle and complete scratch protection for phones
Heavy-duty brass D-ring for car key remotes and AirTags
Locking brass Chicago post with wave washers to maintain key tension
